entries.zh: 禁止；不许、莫给（「莫乞」字面义为『勿给』，禁而不予）
entries.en: to prohibit; to forbid (lit. 'do not give')

entries.zh: 禁止；禁令，亦含下令禁绝之义
entries.en: to prohibit, to forbid; also to command or order
to adopt as one's own son (the ming-ling 'adopted son' trope)
entries.notes: 官话栏残缺，据西语 prohijar 与汉字「螟」（螟蛉承嗣义）定释

entries.zh: 结契收养（认契子）；过继为子
entries.en: to adopt (by covenant or contract) as one's own son
entries.notes: 音写栏拼写存疑（guey/quey），据西语 prohijar 与汉字「契」（契子收养义）定释

entries.zh: 收养为子；抚养（「养子」之养）
entries.en: to adopt and rear as one's own son
entries.notes: 音写后段（c'mauiq）污损难辨，据西语 prohijar 与汉字「養」（养子收养义）定释

entries.zh: 螟蛉（抱养之义子）；收养为嗣
entries.en: an adopted son (classical wasp-foster trope); to adopt as heir

entries.zh: 过房（无子者过继他人之子以承宗嗣）
entries.en: to adopt a son (by family transfer) when one has no children

entries.zh: 说话冗长絮烦、言谈啰嗦惹人厌
entries.notes: 汉字栏「咀渦澈」疑为污损误读、音写栏残缺，仅据西语栏（prolijo, importuno en la platica）定释

entries.zh: 头序（置于卷首之序）；开篇引言
深远、绵长（延长、延伸；如屋宇、道路之深远）
entries.en: to prolong, to lengthen (as a house or road); deep and far-reaching
to promise, to give one's word

entries.zh: 许下（诺言、心愿）；许愿立誓
entries.en: to make a promise, to vow

entries.zh: 〔释义存疑：汉字「下头」字面为『下方』，与西语 prometer（许诺）义不合，疑抄写或归行有误〕
entries.en: uncertain: the Chinese gloss literally reads 'below', which does not match prometer 'to promise'; likely a scribal slip
entries.notes: 「下頭」与 prometer（许诺）义不谐，音写 e juan 亦难对应，存疑不强释
